# `ucase`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
ucase(str)
```

Returns `str` with all characters changed to uppercase.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.1 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT ucase('SparkSql');
```

Result:

```text
SPARKSQL
```
